correctness.rationale: Newton identities give the same characteristic-three quartic and its translation symmetry. A complete cubic-root analysis classifies fifteen singular directions over the algebraic closure. The Hessian has rank three at each base node; the base is integral and its crepant resolution is K3. Exhaustive exact field counts are 25 over F3 and 145 over F9, giving 70 and 280 on the resolution. Weil purity and equality force second-cohomology eigenvalues +3 (21) and -3 (1); hence the displayed zeta function.
